invented.quote: Instead, it stayed on the farms.
invented.why: The brief only says the pantry had to turn the produce down, not what the farms did with it afterward.

invented.quote: The van closes the one gap between food that farmers are already offering and the families who need it.
invented.why: The brief states the pantry turned the produce down because they had no way to pick it up cold or store it, so transportation is not verified to be the only gap.

invented.quote: the families we serve will keep receiving mostly canned and boxed food.
invented.why: The brief does not specify that the remaining non-fresh food consists mostly of canned and boxed items.
